name: Prepare a property maintenance handover
why: Turns open repairs into a job-by-job handover with access notes and overdue decisions, the same output as the repairs and compliance log skill when someone takes over.

name: Property maintenance evidence review assistant
why: Checks repair tickets and closure evidence, matching the 'close with evidence' step before a job leaves the log.

name: Payment reminder letter writer
why: Writes a reminder that keeps goodwill, a useful starting point for the friendly first rent reminder before any formal letter.

name: Complaint reply promise checker
why: Checks a reply to an unhappy tenant or owner for promises the landlord has not approved before it gets the landlord's yes.

name: Handover note writer
why: Writes a note the next person can run from on day one, for when a landlord goes away or a portfolio changes hands.

name: Build a weekly KPI report with a forecast and dashboard
why: A rerunnable report and dashboard for agents managing many owners, extending the monthly owner report.

name: Prepare questions for a property viewing
why: Builds the viewing brief that feeds the 'questions before an offer' step of the deal numbers skill.

name: Bad year plan stress tester
why: Runs bad-year tests on a whole plan, a wider version of the four stress tests used on each rental deal.

name: Floating rate repricing planner
why: Shows the extra interest a rate rise adds loan by loan, useful for a landlord with several variable-rate mortgages.

name: Price against value checker
why: Sets a walk-away price against a value range, a companion to the deal worksheet before an offer.

name: Self-assessment tax return checklist
why: Lists the records a UK landlord gathers and the questions for their accountant, without giving tax rulings.
